verdict.rationale: LlamaParse's dedicated Split API explicitly automates segmenting concatenated PDFs into logical document sections, and Classify auto-categorizes documents by type using natural-language rules, together enabling one-upload, multi-document packet handling with per-document results — Extract can then be applied per classified/split segment. missing for 10: no independent/community validation of Split+Classify pipeline accuracy or an end-to-end worked example combining classify+split+extract in one flow.
